відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"I replaced the ankle boots with a flat pair, since you ruled out heels. The tall tan-brown boots now repeat the camel of the beanie, so that warm colour appears at both ends of the outfit. The brown bag joins the boots in that warm family. Everything between is grey, from the charcoal sweater and scarf to the lighter trousers, with the black coat on top, so the look stays calm and neat for the office. For a long walk in deep frost and snow, the layers are sweater, vest and coat, with the beanie and scarf covering your head and neck. The fitted vest marks your middle, so the wide trousers read as one clean line instead of a second volume next to the sweater.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Button the pinstriped vest over the sweater and put the coat on top, so the vest gives the wide trousers a defined middle to balance against.\",\"Wrap the scarf around your neck and keep it inside the coat's lapels, so its grey sits calmly next to your face.\",\"Black is a good base for the coat in snow and salt, but salty slush wears it faster, so when you arrive shake off the snow and wipe the salt from its hem.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"swap\":{\"item\":\"#395·16\",\"why\":\"occasion\",\"to\":\"#388·06\"},\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#130·43\",\"what\":\"grey pinstriped vest\"},{\"n\":\"#5·29\",\"what\":\"grey sweater\"},{\"n\":\"#90·06\",\"what\":\"wide grey trousers\"},{\"n\":\"#44·23\",\"what\":\"black coat\"},{\"n\":\"#388·06\",\"what\":\"tall flat tan-brown boots\"},{\"n\":\"#495·29\",\"what\":\"camel beanie\"},{\"n\":\"#371·29\",\"what\":\"grey scarf\"},{\"n\":\"#445·07\",\"what\":\"brown bag\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#5·29\",\"text\":\"A regular-cut sweater in deep charcoal grey, a quiet base layer for the whole outfit.\"},{\"n\":\"#90·06\",\"text\":\"Wide-leg trousers in mid grey with a crisp pressed crease down each leg and pointed hems. They also have belt loops and a flap pocket at the back.\"},{\"n\":\"#44·23\",\"text\":\"A regular-cut double-breasted coat in a very dark shade, with wide notched lapels and slim welt pockets. It ends at the hip and has roomy sleeves with turned cuffs.\"},{\"n\":\"#388·06\",\"text\":\"Tall boots covered in long, shaggy tan-brown pile, with a flat sole and a shaft that rises well above the ankle. They are flat, so they fit your no-heels rule.\"},{\"n\":\"#445·07\",\"text\":\"A structured top-handle bag in taupe-brown with a grained finish and a soft flap.
